title: Underlying set and module geometric stalks agree
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ with $\Omega$ a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed]. Define set and module stalks by the pointed-neighbourhood colimit [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], also for separably closed $\Omega$. The canonical map from the stalk of the underlying sheaf of sets of $F$ to the underlying set of the module stalk $F_s$ is a bijection, natural in $F$.
